headline: Western Fronts Surge as Bases Change Hands Rapidly
war_summary: Since the last edition the western arc has intensified. Fishermans Row still leads the turnover tally with forty‑five ownership events in the past day, a modest dip from the prior forty‑nine, while Weathered Expanse has jumped to forty flips and Stlican Shelf to twenty‑five, each showing fresh captures this morning. Callahans Passage, previously quiet at five, now records eleven events, and Deadlands holds steady at fifteen. Stonecradle remains a blood‑soaked crucible, posting three hundred sixty‑seven colonial and two hundred eighty warden casualties per hour, both easing but still extreme. Weathered Expanse casualties are accelerating on both sides, reaching two hundred twenty‑four colonial and three hundred forty warden per hour. Linn Mercy, Loch Mor and Kings Cage also show rising loss rates, whereas Callahans Passage and Oarbreaker report cooling casualty streams. Enlistment surges appear in Deadlands, Linn Mercy, Loch Mor and Stlican Shelf, while Weathered Expanse and Callahans Passage see recruitment waning. The deep Warden interior and the Colonial‑held southern regions continue to show no base turnover.
